reviews.text: Hi, Angie. We appreciate the rating, and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!

Our experience with this clinic was fantastic! We called around 10 vets in London, but they were the only clinic who would see our gerbil for an emergency visit on a Sunday. We were seen as soon as we stepped in the door.

Despite not having a specialism in exotic animals, or having even seen a gerbil before, you wouldn't be able to tell.

Using her knowledge of rodents generally, the vet correctly diagnosed our gerbil, and came up with a treatment plan that worked.

We paid around £200 for this visit - including the fee for out of hours and medication, which we thought was reasonable.

Without the help of this vet / clinic, our gerbil probably would have died - so we are incredibly grateful for them!
Always friendly and available.  Feel very comfortable with this Vet and have used for 7 years
Hi, Sibylle. We must have done something right to get such a good rating from you. We really appreciate you taking the time!

Waited six minutes before hanging up. Normally - this amount of time is negligible but when you have an emergency?? It is everything. Definitely need more support staff if you are going to operate as an “emergency” service. Decided not to register my pup here- terrible first impression.

Whatsapp chat also was only focused on me registering and nothing about my dog
Great vet office in London! Easy to get an appointment, prompt appointments and they've taken good care of our small dog, Roxie!
Failed to see that my cat was dying , and got to her way to late which resulted in her death.

Cons&pros:
CONS:
1. Long wait (4.5/ 5 hrs) due to number of clients/ complicated cases/ not enough vets on that shift (maybe it was just one of those busy days..). I was explained how the clinic works, you get admitted for the day (I was, however, informed about the long wait), that depending on other emergencies being dealt with, could take up to 5hrs/ half a day - it's emergency treatment, like an A&E department.
2. Misdiagnosed issue with my cat's paw as didn't do thorough enough physical check and formulated what it might be without sufficient knowledge of cat's history, although this was provided. I was just told to get my cat to do a number of different expensive tests: xrays, a CT scan and joint taps, to help them figure out what it may be (I'm talking £2500+ which I can't afford). This was a complete waste of my money because all tests came out as "normal". On the CT scan results and joint taps, apparently the results were "vague"! I knew from the beginning that my cat's issue didn't seem too complicated, and I just felt pressurized to do the tests because naturally, I wanted to know what was going on with my cat. I think some vets make a profit from people's general anxiety and fears about their pet's treatment/ wellbeing. (What if they didn't have to rely on technology that much... ? How often do they revise their own learnt academic knowledge, and do CPD, as stated in the RCVS Code of Professional Conduct?) I had at least 3 or more consultations (10 mins each) with them and they still couldn't tell me what he had and insisted on me doing these tests to find out what the issue is aka: "we can't know if we don't do the tests".
3. Miscommunication with other vet partnership (Streatham Vets where I did CT) as to how much money I had claimed from Elizabeth Street  previously, which resulted in issues with my insurance claim and me having to sort it out.
4. Did not call me about results, which they probably got a copy of.
5. Whole clinic seems a bit disorganised, may have been new staff joining or possibly staff struggling to keep on top of admin in a pressurized environment / notes may not be in order so all professionals are not on the same page. Ex: I forgot the instructions given to me by the vet and called to ask, but they couldn't tell me, so instead, they booked me in for another appointment with the same vet (thankfully, I didn't get charged for that 2nd appointment!)

PROS: 1. Registration went smoothly, I was able to easily register via a form, with no complications or pre-payments needed. Provided me with an paper estimate of cost of treatment (when I  asked in person as opposed to over the phone). They should provide this by law.
2. Said they cared for my cat well (hydrated and kept cool while waiting), and went over the procedures before and after treatment.
3. I saw main vet Lillian who gave me a good  explanation of how to go through testing procedure but was unable to  help with regards to actually determining the cause of my cat's inflammed paws without doing the tests. It turned out to be a simple inflamation or iritation, not "arthritis". However, she did do extra tests I asked for on the spot (FLV) and did not charge me for coming twice to ask about what I'm supposed to do following her instructions. I believe she did not do a thorough enough physical check of my cat's paws.
4. Vets checked on my cat several times while I was there, and let me know when his turn was to do the x-ray, as no exact time period was given as to how long I should wait.
5. Gave me medication for treatment that is less strong than usual, as my cat reacted to stronger medication.
6. Reception saff provided me with explanations to most of my questions, to those they could answer about procedures and insurance. The clinic put the insurance claim through for me, after treatment (standard procedure, but can also do pre-authorisations for insurance, if asked 2 days prior).
7. Waiting room a had aircon and water for pets available.

Our dog was referred to Elizabeth Street for her follow-up appointments after her operation at the Streatham Hill.
The care and service that was offered was brilliant and with so much care for our dog.
Thank you very much for ensuring that she had what she needed towards her recovery.

Thank you

My Whippet was caught in a drain and the firemen rescued her cutting her out of tiny slots, I then took her to the Elizabeth Street Vet who weee helpful and understanding! My whippet walked home! Thank you
Excellent 24 hour service - thank you
Hi, Peter. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!

Avoid at all costs.
Very disorganized and bad communication.
My dog has been in pain for a month because of them.
My last vet was over charging me for medication. Here I had a much better experience

Huge thanks to this veterinary clinic. They took in my cat in the middle of the night, treating us with both professionalism and warmth. Unfortunately, I couldn't afford the diagnostic tests because I live on a disability pension. However, the vet examined my cat and didn't charge me for the visit. Before I left, I was given a pouch of special food suited to my cat's condition. Earlier that night, I had tried to contact the PDSA but was turned away because I hadn't renewed my annual registration—since my two cats had been healthy, I hadn't thought it necessary. By morning, however, I finally managed to get that sorted out. My cat is doing much better now; she finally got the help she needed and is able to relieve herself again. Once again, I would like to thank this private clinic for the tremendous support, human approach, and understanding they showed us, as well as for reassuring us that everything would be alright. ❤️
Couldn’t recommend this practice more - they were so kind when I brought in my ill dachshund out of hours, really lovely staff and incredible care

It was an extraordinary experience of efficiency and understanding and I couldn’t be happier with your services. I live around the corner and I’m very happy to have such a wonderful surgery next door. Thank you so much from me and Loki.
Seen quickly on a Sunday; thorough examination and all very clearly explained.  Dog on the mend!
Hi, J. We are delighted that you had a great experience with us. Thank you for taking the time to rate us!
Very good experience lovely people I'm glad to have picked your veterinary clinic  10 out of 10

I visited Elizabeth Street for an out of hours emergency because our cat had something stuck in his throat. The team saw us straight away, even though it was late at night. Dr. Hinnah was amazing and I trusted that even if he needed surgery he was in safe hands with her. Thankfully she was able to remove the obstruction without the need for a surgical proceedure, which potentially saved us thousands of pounds. What a hero! I can’t thank Hinnah and the team enough.

My daughter took my ginger kitten Leo to this vet for neutering.   He was made a huge fuss of and when he came home he acted as if nothing had been done!

The service was fantastic, and we were all very happy, especially Leo!

My dog has been registered with Elizabeth St for many years now and I’ve always found the service helpful, compassionate and efficient. I telephoned the emergency line at 3am as my dog was showing the symptoms of heatstroke and I was very panicked. This was naturally an urgent situation. I spoke to Nathaly who could not have been more dismissive and really added to the stress of the situation. I appreciate that emergency teams are sometimes overstretched and an immediate appointment is not possible, even in an emergency, but I was shocked that she could not even offer any advice or guidelines as to how best to keep my dog safe whilst I tracked down an appointment or provide me with any advice. In the end Medivet in Kensington were able to see my dog within half an hour.
Such a disappointing attitude and lack of “bedside” manner.

Such sweet people. My poor male cat was incredibly unwell and I had to rush home to rush him to Elizabeth Street Veterinary Clinic straight after work at around midnight. The vet was incredibly kind and gentle with him and very precise in telling me the issue and what medication to give him. Really couldn't recommend this practice enough. Thanks so much.
Very friendly and professional doctors
Excellent care for my pooch in moments of distress.

Charlie, my little dog, had quite a complex procedure for replacement of cruciate ligament. Dario was so so caring and went over the top. I am so happy that I went to Elizavet. If you are considering any VET for any operation or procedure, well look no further. Luca Raimondi

I always leave Elizabeth Street impressed!
Bertie hurt his eye and as our regular vet was closed, I called Elizabeth Street and was able to bring him in straight away.
The receptionist, both on the phone and in person, was lovely and helped calm what was a stressful situation.

Donna, the vet, quickly identified what was going on with Bertie's eye and had a wealth of knowledge about his breed.
The consultation fee is very fair in my opinion and I left feeling reassured that Bertie will be back to his usual self soon.

Thank you to the entire Elizabeth Street team!
Hi, Telisa. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Thank you so much for the review!
Hi, Emily. We appreciate the rating, and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!
Always helpful as an out of hours vet. Great team!
Brilliant 👌 👍
Fantastic efficient and caring clinic for over 39 years

So grateful to have come across this emergency clinic, they took care of my cat so well , reassured me and kept me informed about his health. Price is understandably steep as it is an emergency visit in the middle of the night however they offered payment plan which was great. Highly recommend, my baby is safe at home with me now :)
Friendly and helpful staff, caring and attentive vets, and a warm, welcoming atmosphere.
Hi, Char. We must have done something right to get such a good rating from you. We really appreciate you taking the time!
A very knowledgeable and compassionate team who support you when you need it the most.
Huge thanks for helping Filou last night and for being so considerate about our circumstances ❤️
Thank you so much for taking a good care of our precious Barny (cat). I was in panic and you find time slot for us to check him. He says Hi and thank you
Hi, George. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!

If you are an animal lover like me, you would be thankful this vet hospital, Doctor Dario and his Team exist; they are simply the best, passionate about their job and the pets, modern equipments! AMAZING!!!
I will absolutely use them again if needed ! Fair prices for emergency, and Donna the vet that visited Rocky was excellent and extremely knowledgeable. I couldn’t recommend them enough!
Had a Saturday appointment at very short notice and the vet sorted out the problem instantly. Would highly recommend
The service from the receptionists to the vets is 100% professional. They show true love and care for the pets.
Hi, Lola. We are delighted that you had a great experience with us. Thank you for taking the time to rate us!

We're not regular vet users, but our cat has always been healthy and active. We had a serious concern one evening, so I looked for an emergency out-of-hours clinic and was pointed in the direction of ESVC. We were looked after with real care from start to finish. In short, they were lovely people. The vet and the nurse dealt with a very busy evening with calm and kindness. The vet was clear about pricing and options; she didn't hurry me along, even though I knew that their clinic was full. The nurse was amazing at keeping me informed throughout (and I was there for quite a while). Even though the clinic isn't local to us, I'll definitely think about them first in the future.

The team showed exceptional care for our dog Bowie, when he was very poorly and required round- the -clock treatment. The level of compassion, professionalism and dedication they provided was outstanding, and we always felt he was in the best possible hands. We are so grateful for the excellent care Bowie received. We would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a caring and trustworthy veterinary practice.

So grateful for the superb support, expertise and resolution. The staff were effortlessly professional - welcoming and helpful, perceptive and articulate - models of their kind. A brilliant place. Delighted to be registered and to know that they are there...24/7 ...amazing hey!

We cannot thank Elizabeth Street Veterinary Clinic enough for the incredible care they gave our little Honey during a very scary incident. The team acted so quickly, and genuinely they saved her life.

A special thank you to Alina, whose compassion, professionalism, and reassurance meant the world to us during such a stressful time. You can tell she truly cares about the animals, not just the treatment.

It’s rare to find a vet that prioritises care and wellbeing over pushing costs, and that made all the difference to us. Because of this experience, we’ll now be transferring all three of our pets here without hesitation.

We’re beyond grateful, thank you again for everything.

Swift and easy to book an appointment on the day

Very sympathetic vet who was friendly and put my cat at ease.
Super friendly staff, very helpful, understanding and kind, my cat stayed there for an emergency one eve, the vet very informative, would highly recommend
Not a long wait at all. Vet listened, took notes and gave course of  antibiotics. Advised best care and to follow up within a few days. All in all reassuring.

I was so nervous they put me at ease so much, my cat is so comfortable after surgery, I really can not recommend theses, from the first phone call, meeting the receptionists and then the vets thank you so much for your support
A place where I have peace of mind in the care of my pet .

I am very happy with the care my cats receive from Elizabeth Street Vets. The Vets are always so friendly, reassuring and helpful. I have been bringing my cats so this Vets for many years following a recommendation and I will continue to do so. Highly recommended.
Hi, Vetina. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Thank you so much for the review!

From the phone call I knew it was going to be good .the knowledge was brilliant and they really care and don't be put of by it been in Belgravia it was very reasonable on price and made me feel so confident for the cat all I can say is thankyou for your care , experience and advice and not complicating the service you gave us .and it really was dealt with like an emergency Simba is in a much better place today
Very helpful and kind to pets and did thorough check on my parrot

Experienced, friendly and attentive staff. My dog spent her last 2 days there and I know she was in good hands. They also helped us to make the hardest decision ever and walked us thru the process with empathy
Very friendly and helpful always. Thank you
Hi, David. We must have done something right to get such a good rating from you. We really appreciate you taking the time!
Hi, Alex. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!
Hi, Kristina. We are delighted that you had a great experience with us. Thank you for taking the time to rate us!

My dog had been unwell for a few days and I decided he needed to see the vets. I visited Elezabeth Stret Veterinary Clinic out of hours and the team provided excellent car, doing a thorough check over of my dog and clearly explaining what they were doing and what they thought was wrong with him.
The costs were very reasonable, the staff were friendly and efficient and I will definitely use them again for any vet needs.
Always kind and always prompt communication.
Hi, Zak. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Thank you so much for the review!
Hi, Thomas. We appreciate the rating, and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!
Great staff. Great place.

Friendly staff , a big thank you to Dr Lilia for looking after our 2 dogs so well , she’s so attentive never rush’s anything and explains everything so we understand what’s going one , thank you to everyone

I am completely disgusted with this veterinary clinic. How is it that to get my dog ​​the same pill they prescribed a few months ago, I have to see the vet again? They don't think about their clients. How much does an appointment cost just for half an eye on a dog? They barely touch him. The appointments don't even last 20 minutes, and they charge over 100 pounds just to examine a dog. I need some pills because he scratches a lot, and they tell me the vet has to examine him. What are they going to examine if the dog is fine? He just scratches a lot. What is there to examine? It's a complete racket. They know perfectly well that the law requires dogs to be seen by vets, and they abuse that. For 15 minutes of half an eye on a dog that's perfectly fine, they charge an arm and a leg.
As usual, excellent service! Thanks guys!
Excellent service

I took Kiwi, my 10 years old cat with painful gums in an emergency visit this morning, the receptionist was very helpful and kind, the Vet ( Emilia) was really good, took time to examine him, helping with his pain etc . 10 ⭐
Fantastic vet clinic, super kind and friendly staff.

Nellie our pug needed emergency care on a Sunday night, Elizabeth Street vet took Nellie even though she was not a registered patient, the care and kindness Nellie received was fantastic, they called several times a days with updates and when calling, you are never re-routed to a answering service but to a very helpful receptionist, my family and I highly recommend this practice.  Thank you again for all your help in nursing Nellie back to health.
Highly recommend bringing your fur baby to this clinic. Wonderful staff, clean, responsive and very reasonably priced. Penelope and myself will be back

Donna and LeeAnn gave outstanding emergency veterinary care to my Bengal cat. My cat is not the biggest fan of the vet but both clinicians settled him quickly and effectively and he even looked relaxed at the end of the appointment. The service was exceptional, great communication, calm and professional manner, efficient, kind and caring. I cannot more highly recommend this clinic. I am so grateful to you both.

We had some issues with one of their partner clinics and Elizabeth St took our puppy in overnight and looked after her SO well, what went from an emergency was smoothly handled by the professionals at Elizabeth St, although they are a fair drive from our home they are worth the effort knowing my dog is in good hands

A very disorganised vet clinic, it does the job but don't expect a lot from them. Every time I ask for something (prescription, medicine, etc.), it takes the receptionist team 2 or 3 tries to provide it. Also, there are always hidden costs which are not explained upfront.

I would like to extend my deepest gratitude to the entire team at Elizabeth Street Veterinary Hospital for the exceptional care they provided to my cat, Speedo. We arrived in an urgent situation, and from the very first moment, the staff acted with remarkable efficiency, professionalism, and genuine compassion.

Speedo was treated promptly, thoroughly, and with such gentle expertise that I felt completely reassured during a very stressful time. Every step of the process was handled with care and clarity, and it was evident that the wellbeing of animals truly comes first here.

Thank you for responding so quickly, treating Speedo so well, and delivering such outstanding veterinary support. I am sincerely grateful and would highly recommend Elizabeth Street Veterinary Hospital to anyone seeking excellent and reliable care for their pets.

Jellica
The people who work here are amazing and so professional. They did everything to help my cat and it was everything I hoped for.

Good staff.doctor carry my door, help him .
Kindly and professional.
Thank you
Amazing and friendly.  Even my Denzel liked the entire team.   not only did they treat the issue but any extra help or recommendation you can see they really cared.   Very big thank you.
When I have an after hours emergency with my two problem dogs, this is where I go

I was in a desperate situation with my beloved, blue, Budgie, Chicken Nugget.   The Vets helped her immediately, doing what they could, while being open and honest about their level of Bird knowledge, and keeping me updated throughout.

The Staff, and the male, (I believe he was Polish?) Vet in particular, was kind, supportive, non-judgemental when I cried, caring, understanding, and informative. That gentleman who looked after Chicken Nugget, gave exemplary care (as did all the Staff), while being honest and transparent about the situation, and administered emergency care immediately, at a time when I felt so desperately helpless to help her.

He saved our Chicken Nugget's life, that night. He has our eternal thanks.
Brilliant Vet!
...................
Sadly our beloved little girl, passed away weeks later, on Monday 27th October 2025, at 9:23am ... but it was certainly NOT as a result of anything any Vet did, or through any fault (there was none!) in the wonderful care and assistance of Elizabeth Street Vets.

They gave us many more weeks of extra, happier times, with our beautiful, little, Chicken Nugget, and many more happy memories, that she and we, never would have shared, without their kind, and wonderful assistance, that night.

Thank you Elizabeth Street Vets - especially the male Vet who helped us.
We shall always be grateful, for all you did for Chicken Nugget, and our family.
Thank you.

The practice suggested stool tests for my dog, which I thought was a good idea. However, it took more than two weeks to receive the results, and I had to chase for updates during that time. When I raised a complaint, I was told there had been an issue with the external lab, but that I should have been kept informed. The person I spoke with apologised for this and was very gracious, offering a refund of the consultation fee, which I appreciated. The vet was excellent.
Reliable, friendly and knowledgeable.
Hi, Mallika. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!
Great clinic, loved how they answered immediately and were very attentive with my friend’s dog! Everything went by so smoothly and perfectly!
They were great! I rushed my cat in during their emergency hours, the team were so kind and helpful.
As always, Elizabeth Street Vet did a magnificent job with my elderly dog. Every time I  leave I feel that we were looked after sensitively with state of the art care.

We had the absolute best experience we could have ever asked for. The care, the attention, the communication and the team were outstanding. Everything was beyond my expectations and I can not recommend the clinic, the doctors and the staff more. 10 stars
Very faster reply by the phone ,doctors amazing very kind and professional! I was surprised 😳 cost not Hight …
Life saving emergency care with no wait - incredibly grateful. God send!  Smart capable and transparent vet Mimi is a star!
Amazing and so helpful thank you!
Excellent 24 hour care and service. The whole team were fantastic in looking after my cat. He was in for 3 days. I had regular updates by  both the night staff and day staff. Would highly recommend.
Amazing vets, so kind and helpful. They did the aftercare for my cat post op from another vet where we’d had a bad experience and they were absolutely amazing. If I could give 10 stars I would.
Hi, Daniela. We must have done something right to get such a good rating from you. We really appreciate you taking the time!
Very friendly, helpful and efficient

The whole experience was easy from start to finish vet was great put us all at ease including the cat which I thought was impossible as the cats scared of everything would totally recomend to everyone

I visited Elizabeth Street with Angus Thursday 11 September 2025. The evening before I spoke to a very helpful receptionist from New Zealand who took the time and care to ask a vet for and provide advice on things to help Angus who gets quite stressed. On the day reception staff again were helpful and friendly referring to Angus by name. I saw Lilia who was great at handling Angus giving him time and space before starting the examination. The advice and information I was provided was thorough and helped me to decide the next course of action / treatment. I was most impressed with how Lilia gave Angus time and space to feel comfortable and calmly and confidently examined him with gentleness and care. I wasn't surprised that Lilia had her own cat and was very caring. A good experience. Thanks to all involved including reception staff, vetenary assistant and Lilia the vet for making the visit for Angus and me less stressful.

We needed an emergency vet at 1am.
The vet and team were absolutely brilliant.
Thank you
Nice place
Hi, Denis. We are delighted that you had a great experience with us. Thank you for taking the time to rate us!

Thank you ESVC team for looking after our  Gandalf over the weekend.

Vet Lilia was absolutely amazing, kept us updated during his stay (detailed phone calls),  the care, advise (and opinion), follow up call to explain test results and treatment action plan going forward even though ESVC isn't our registered vet.

Thank you for your care and kindness Lilia.
Literally saved my dog's life in a very scary and acute situation in the middle of the night.  Thanks for being there for us.

Excellent  service .We wanted to expresse our sincere thanks for the successful dental extractions for our dog Coco. .We noticed   a huge difference in her comfort and happiness almost immediately . We truly  appreciate everything you've done for Coco.   Many thanks

Unfortunately had to visit Elizabeth Street vets last Saturday evening with my dog. This practice has now been taken over by another money grabbing group DNA. I was told the consultation would be £99 which is fair but what they charge you for drugs is outrageous.
A bottle of Medicam £32.68 Viovet price £2.89
Synolux tablets (10) £43.65 these tablets are 0.80p each. Then two injections came to £67

The vet was nice enough but didn’t really know what the problem was, the consultation room was dirty and miserable, the receptionist even more miserable someone who should definitely consider a career change. When people have to visit an emergency vet it’s because it’s an Emergency and one is worried for their pet it would be nice to be greeted by someone with some empathy.
My advice is to avoid this practice and try to find another Out of Hours Vet Practice.
Extremely rude
My cat is much better thank you 😄 …
Kind caring vets

Elani is a brilliant and dedicated professional with natural love for any animals. Also highly skilled despite her young age. Would definitely trust the life of any of my pets. Her receptionist is great as well. Thank you for your help guys.
Hi, Susannah. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Thank you so much for the review!
Our cat had a seizure late at night so we came as an emergency case. Everyone was really wonderful, we felt supported and that he was very well taken care of. Thank you so much

Absolutely fantastic service by the lady at reception and Donna the vet who dealt with my dogs emergency. Donna is 100% a credit to this vet practice. Every step of the examination she explained to us. It didn’t take long for her to diagnose the problem and the medications she was giving. The side effects these 2 medications had and what to do especially if he had a reaction to these. I would 100% recommend this vet practice who went above and beyond with their care in looking after my Pomeranian Titan
Very helpful made time to see Reggie today as he was only using 3 legs … hopefully now have got medication that will work
Friendly and professional. Large dog feels much better.
My first visit to ESVC was a very welcoming and pleasant experience. I'd definitely recommend them to anyone looking for a new vet, or for those, like me, seeking a vet for their very first pet.
Hi, George. We appreciate the rating, and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!

We took our cat to the clinic, a referred by our usual vet, to have him checked over for an infection and obviously not being well. He is now back home with the other two cats and enjoying his usual activities. Regrettably we will have to go back as some ongoing issues were discovered.
The clinic seems popular and wait time on the phone and in the practice can be a bit long, as a minor gripe.
Pricing also  appeared reasonable, with all the work done and time invested.

This is possibly the worst vet ever. My dog wasn’t well so I made an appointment. The female vet was beyond horrible. I then had to return later in the evening and the male vet was lovely although I don’t know that he did his best. I then made another appointment for the Sunday as my dog was still unwell and the awful female vet was on duty (They’ve since parted company with her) and the receptionist said I could go to another practice. We were treated so kindly by Felicity at Streatham and she couldn’t have been so kind. Sadly my dog wasn’t well and had to be put to sleep and they said they would keep him as I wanted to bury him. I returned later in the week to collect him and they were lovely. Sadly I couldn’t leave until the Sunday so I took him to Elizabeth Street which was a massive mistake. I arrived to collect him on the Sunday having called them and was made to wait for 30 minutes. He was handed to me by the most unsympathetic nurse I’ve ever come across  she literally handed me a bag with my dead dog inside. I asked where his blankets were and she accused me of lying about them and said she didn’t know anything. Eventually she found them and gave them to me. It was the worst situation ever and she was a complete so and so.  To make me wait 30 minutes to collect my dead dog and be so horrible isn’t acceptable so avoid at all costs.
Great service bought my dog in as an emergency he had a reaction to something, bought him in at 11pm he was treated he is well. So happy I found this place they saved my dog. Thank you.
Amazing emergency service for my rabbit. So comforting and answered all my questions. Definitely recommend.

Couldn’t recommend the clinic more! I rang in when my dog was sick late on a Friday night and the team gave me an emergency appointment within 2 hours. Elani was excellent and spent 45 mins with us properly checking our dog, and explaining everything and answering all our questions. Thank you!

Great experience for out of hours emergency care for my cat. Our vet Szymon was very knowledgeable and caring and really took his time to try and find what the issue was and what would be the best solutions.
Excellent service and thorough! Very happy
Hi, Roberta. We are delighted that you had a great experience with us. Thank you for taking the time to rate us!
Hi, Graciela. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Thank you so much for the review!

Terrible inexperienced vet at the weekend completely overwhelmed by what turned out to out to be a common condition
I still have not got over the stress of trying to deal with this place
They have no obvious tariff of prices and are really shifty when you ask for costs
If a scan is needed you should just be told the price and the reason
Not be given a ridiculous option short scan,scan with a report etc
Unbelievable !! It’s all about the money with this place
To be avoided at all costs
Hi, Lize. We appreciate the rating, and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!
Great vet clinic, very thorough and easy to schedule
I love this place. They are always available and everyone is nice. It may be a little more expensive than other vets but it’s because they are open 24/7 which is extremely helpful

Excellent service!  I am so pleased.  I took my cat Pepsi for an emergency appointment.  We got a time slot immediately.   On arrival the reception staff were very friendly and helpful.  We were seen very quickly and did not wait long at all for the vet to call us in.  The vets name was Ilhami Inan - he was outstanding!  He thoroughly examined my cat, explained everything very clearly and gave expert advice.  He was brilliant, very knowledgeable and professional. He sent off for some tests and gave Pepsi some fluids  and medication.  By the time we got home Pepsi had already improved and seemed so much better!  Ilhami even called later on to update me on one of the results which was very helpful and put my mind at ease.  Overall, this vets made such a stressful experience so much more bearable.  The clinic itself was very lovely, clean and well kept.  I will be coming to this vets in future.  It is not even local to me but is most definitely worth the longer drive and going that bit further afield for such excellent care.  I would 100% recommend

I’ve been a client for almost 10 years. Things didn’t run smoothly but the clinic is close to the house, so I stayed. But today they sent me an estimate of 800!£ for lungs x-ray. The spaying surgery and 2 teeth extraction that we did in that clinic was the same or less cost. This is just a simple x-ray. The bill came next day after I had a consult with vet where we discussed the dog’s condition and further X-ray. The consultation was paid for. After visiting London over the weekend and my dog falling ill, I attended this clinic overnight for some care.
The vet who saw my dog was really helpful and gave him an antiemetic injection and advised to observe overnight and any deterioration to return.
Unfortunately he woke up so much worse, I contacted the clinic expressing my concerns, and they advised they would be able to see me at 12pm but if I wished to come in, they may see me before but I would have to wait.
I attended the clinic as instructed and on arrival was told they wouldn't be able to see me before 12pm despite my concerns with my pet and having travelled with him in discomfort all the way there after being told otherwise.
I luckily managed to get an appointment at another vet, who not only listened to my concerns but were quick to react.
By 12pm, the time I was due to be seen at Elizabeth vet, my dog had already had scans and been taken to emergency surgery at the other vets and had woken up from surgery.
Turns out he had swollen an onion which is fatal and this in turn was becoming very toxic in his system.
Even though I was happy with the care overnight, I don't think my concerns were seen as an emergency the following day when clearly my dog was really suffering and could have ended fatally.

Very lovely and professional vet, down to earth and taking care of the best interest of your pet.
